critique: The geological metaphor creates strong conceptual cohesion between spending layers and earth strata, but the execution undermines this clarity through inconsistent visual hierarchy—the percentage labels float ambiguously while category descriptions lack systematic placement. The craft shows in thoughtful color gradients that reinforce depth, yet the interaction model breaks the metaphor by mixing geological terms with conventional UI patterns like 'Necessity Depth' tooltip, creating cognitive dissonance between the innovative framework and standard financial app behaviors.
